title: petasites niveus
intro: Petasites niveus, commonly known as White Butterbur, is a perennial plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, offering several health benefits, including reducing symptoms of migraines and allergic rhinitis, as well as providing protection against cardiovascular diseases and neurodegenerative disorders. The therapeutic actions of White Butterbur are attributed to its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and cytokines, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Petasites niveus include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
